title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE: JPM) — Fortress Banking Franchise Rejected on Stage 4 Breakdown & Compressed Reclaim Asymmetry
primer: JPMorgan Chase & Co. earns 20% Q3 2026 ROTCE across $5.21 trillion in AUM and a 14.0% CET1 capital base. Fresh audit drags from -$19.82 billion AOCI marks, $25.84 billion unrecorded HTM losses (-$7.38/sh after tax), halted buybacks, ~$108.6 billion opex, and 2028 G-SIB rules compress normalized ROTCE to 18.5% (2.50x P/TBV = $302.75 stated / $284.30 HTM-adjusted Base). At $310.68 (2.76x stated TBV / 2.95x HTM-adjusted TBV), shares broke into Stage 4 on 1.73x volume during an S&P 500 Downtrend. Because Base fair value sits below both CMP and the $334.16–$337.35 reclaim band over Pivot S2 ($315.27), we assign REJECTED (TIER_0) with zero shares held.
verdict_rule_summary: Reject new capital when a stock breaks into Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED) and its reconciled 2.50x Base fair value ($302.75 stated / $284.30 HTM-adjusted) sits below both CMP ($310.68) and the post-reclaim Stage 2 entry band ($334.16–$337.35) above Pivot S2 ($315.27), yielding negative asymmetry (< 0:1 vs. 1.50:1 hurdle).
sizing_table_takeaway: At $310.68 in Stage 4 above our reconciled $302.75 stated ($284.30 HTM-adjusted) Base fair value, post-reclaim asymmetry is negative against a $315.27 Pivot S2 reference, so REJECTED (TIER_0) sets live risk budget and target allocation to 0.0%.
holding_rationale: Per the November 20, 2026 consolidated US positions ledger, JPM is not held in either Charles Schwab or Robinhood (0 shares). Live close ($310.68) breached the prior November 13 structural stop ($322.51), which would have triggered an exit if held; with 0 shares owned, keep 100% of marginal US cash ($2,540.35) in reserve.

holding_alerts.trigger: Prior structural stop breached ($322.51) with 0 shares held
holding_alerts.instruction: No shares held (NOT_HELD); do not catch the Stage 4 decline at $310.68 while 4H trend turn remains false.

holding_alerts.trigger: Stage 2 reclaim check above 30W/50D SMA ($334.16–$337.35) on >1.2x volume
holding_alerts.instruction: Do not auto-buy on reclaim alone unless Base fair value expands above $371 (via AOCI healing and resumed >$5B buybacks) to restore >=1.50:1 asymmetry over Pivot S2 ($315.27).

Keep JPM sidelined on Watchlist; re-evaluate only after BOTH a completed multi-week Stage 1 base forms AND either a high-volume Stage 2 reclaim or >=1.50:1 asymmetry anchored to HTM-adjusted TBVPS ($105.26 current / $113.72 forward).

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal unit of investable US cash ($2,540.35 cash available across $75,110.60 consolidated US net worth; 0 shares of JPM held so no sale proceeds are freed)

destinations.recommendation: Hold 100% of the $2,540.35 marginal US cash reserve during JPM's Stage 4 breakdown and the S&P 500 Downtrend (10 distribution days; 38.8% above 50-DMA).
destinations.rationale: Portfolio effective beta exposure already sits at 234.2% against a thin 3.38% cash cushion, while JPM sits in Stage 4 above reconciled Base fair value ($302.75 stated / $284.30 HTM-adjusted).
destinations.entry_condition: Await S&P 500 breadth recovery above 50% and a verified Stage 2 setup clearing >=1.50:1 support asymmetry.

destinations.recommendation: Monitor Stage 2 shortlist comparator ABBV ($286.20; snapshot zone $277.05–$285.49; stop $249.53; Base $340.00; 1.52:1 support R:R) without deploying cash during macro Downtrend.
destinations.rationale: ABBV passes Stage 2 (BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO, 10.68% TTM revenue growth, 36.18% OPM) and clears 1.50:1 at snapshot support, but portfolio cash preservation takes priority in a Downtrend.
destinations.entry_condition: Pullback into $277.05–$285.49 support once S&P 500 distribution pressure abates.

destinations.recommendation: Track outside comparator LNG ($294.84; snapshot zone $287.06–$295.80; stop $262.23; Nov 20 dossier verdict REJECTED at $315.00 Base; 0.57:1 snapshot-zone R:R) as reference only.
destinations.rationale: Although LNG prints a Stage 2 chart, its November 20, 2026 dossier rejected fresh capital at a $315.00 Base target (0.57:1 R:R over $262.23 stop) due to post-Hormuz FCF normalization and $24.14B gross debt.
destinations.entry_condition: Requires deeper valuation reset or higher normalized FCF visibility; zero new capital allocated.

ch4.stage_explanation: Closed at $310.68 below falling 50D SMA ($337.35), 30W SMA ($334.16), 200D SMA ($325.20), and prior $322.51 stop on 1.73x 30D volume (snapshots STAGE_4 / CAP_REJECTED overrides facts Stage 1 proximity tag).
ch4.evaluation_stage_explanation: Snapshot evaluator classifies JPM as STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED) due to -7.91% 50D SMA and -7.03% 30W SMA deficits; facts ledger Stage 1 tag reflects only 0.17 ATR distance to $309.18 63D low.
ch4.posture_explanation: AVOID_STAGE4_OR_BROKEN technical ceiling forbids IMMEDIATE_BUY or ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP; reconciled Base fair value ($302.75 stated / $284.30 HTM-adjusted) sits below the reclaim band, yielding negative R:R (< 0:1 vs. 1.50:1 hurdle).
ch4.support_zone_explanation: Stage-4-reclaim threshold ($334.16 30W SMA to $337.35 50D SMA); monitor only because reconciled Base fair value ($302.75 stated / $284.30 HTM-adjusted) sits below the reclaim band and Pivot S2 ($315.27), yielding negative asymmetry (< 0:1).
ch4.stop_placement_explanation: Pivot S2 ($315.27) sits $18.89–$22.08 (2.39x–2.79x ATR14 of $7.92) below the $334.16–$337.35 reclaim zone; reference level only while REJECTED.

valuation_assessment.posture: Slightly Full vs. Reconciled 2.50x Base ($302.75 stated / $284.30 HTM-adjusted)
valuation_assessment.note: At $310.68, JPM trades at 13.03x TTM P/E, 2.76x stated Q3 TBVPS ($112.64), and 2.95x HTM-adjusted TBVPS ($105.26), pricing 20.06%–21.20% implied ROTCE vs. 2.50x ($302.75 / $284.30) at 18.5% normalized ROTCE.

ch4.tech_table_takeaway: JPMorgan Chase broke below its 50-day ($337.35), 30-week ($334.16), and 200-day ($325.20) moving averages on 1.73x 30-day volume, locking the tape into Stage 4 during an S&P 500 Downtrend.
ch4.gate_table_takeaway: Both the snapshot technical gate (STAGE_4 / CAP_REJECTED) and our reconciled valuation asymmetry test (< 0:1 post-reclaim R:R to $302.75 Base vs. 1.50:1 minimum) converge on REJECTED for new capital.
ch4.intro_prose: Live multi-timeframe market data as of November 20, 2026 shows JPMorgan Chase's technical structure deteriorating from Stage 3 into Stage 4 on heavy volume. The TradingView chart and deterministic ledger below summarize every moving average, pivot shelf, and momentum gauge.
ch4.gate_intro_prose: We test both the mechanical Stage 4 ceiling and the post-reclaim reward-to-risk ratio so our capital decision remains free of hedging or conflicting trigger levels.
ch4.closing_prose: Until JPMorgan completes a multi-week Stage 1 base AND either reclaims $334.16–$337.35 with Base fair value lifted above $371 or builds a lower Stage 2 structure offering >=1.50:1 asymmetry anchored to HTM-adjusted TBVPS, new equity capital remains sidelined.

gate_exceptions: Environment & Browser Tooling Note: This run executed in a Linux cloud workspace. WeasyPrint, macOS Chrome automation, and TheWrap-Chrome tabs are unavailable here. As a result, options_snapshot.py used public options chain data (NO_OPTIONS_EDGE: $310/$330 call spread at 1.09:1 R:R). Companion PDF generation for JPM_book.pdf is deferred to a WeasyPrint host. A separate Q3 2026 Q&A transcript was not in the cache, so CEO and CFO quotes come straight from SEC EDGAR Form 8-K Ex. 99.1 (Oct 13, 2026) and Form 8-K (Nov 17, 2026).

Weinstein Stage Ledger Split (facts Stage 1 vs. snapshots STAGE_4): facts_US_2026-11-20.json tags JPM as Stage 1 (Basing) based on a 0.17 ATR gap to its $309.18 63-day low. Yet that same file notes a FALLING/FLAT 50-day SMA ($337.35), a -3.39 ATR deficit, and -3.22% 63D RS. snapshots_US_2026-11-20.json assigns STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED) because $310.68 sits -7.91% below the 50-day SMA, -7.03% below the 30-week SMA ($334.16), and -4.46% below the 200-day SMA ($325.20). We adopt STAGE_4.
